# PyImageSearch

> > PyImageSearch is the definitive resource for mastering computer vision, deep learning, and OpenCV through comprehensive tutorials, courses, and books.

Founded by Adrian Rosebrock, PyImageSearch provides over 350+ free tutorials alongside premium courses through PyImageSearch University. The site covers practical applications from object detection with YOLO to embedded vision on Raspberry Pi, serving both beginners and advanced practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Computer Vision
- Deep Learning
- OpenCV
- Object Detection
- YOLO
- TensorFlow & Keras
- Python
- Raspberry Pi
- Machine Learning
- Educational Resources
- Practical Projects
- Neural Networks
- Image Processing

## Getting Started

- [PyImageSearch Homepage](https://pyimagesearch.com): PyImageSearch homepage offering Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and OpenCV mastery.
- [Start Here with Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and OpenCV](https://pyimagesearch.com/start-here): Step-by-step guide to getting started with Computer Vision, Deep Learning, OpenCV.
- [Topics and Categories](https://pyimagesearch.com/topics): Directory of 350+ free Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and OpenCV tutorials.

## Learning Resources & Courses

- [PyImageSearch University](https://pyimagesearch.com/pyimagesearch-university): PyImageSearch University online courses by Adrian Rosebrock on Computer Vision.
- [Books and Courses](https://pyimagesearch.com/books-and-courses): PyImageSearch books and courses catalog for Computer Vision and Deep Learning.
- [Blog](https://pyimagesearch.com/blog): Weekly blog posts and tutorials on Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and OpenCV.
